willen.pt: causa (for my sake: por minha causa)

abwenden.en: to avert, to turn to the side

heucheln.en: to feign (friendship, morality, etc.); to be hypocritical

geschenkt.en: forget it, forget about it, nevermind, that’s not so problematic, that’s one thing, that’s not the worst part

vorhalte.en: reproach, confrontation with something from one’s own sphere

bedeuten.en: to interpret (e.g. dreams), to understand, to read (e.g. signs)

freundlichkeit.en: kindness, friendliness (the state of being kind)

spotten.en: to scoff, to jeer, to mock
